g.text: Epoch's cost model puts roughly two-thirds of the capital in chips

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 10.2px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: What it shows: observed capital cost split into compute hardware and construction, by owner. In Epoch's cost model the two

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 10.2px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: sum exactly to the capital total, so the split is arithmetic rather than an estimate layered on top.

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 8.6px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Source: Epoch AI, AI Data Centers (CC-BY) — https://epoch.ai/data/ai-data-centers

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 8.6px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows Epoch AI's published data centers documentation

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Note: Observed data only, at the 2026-08-06 snapshot. Across all tracked sites, chips are $316bn of $459bn capital (68.9%) and buildings

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: $143bn (31.1%). Annual operating cost, a flow rather than a stock, runs a further $10.9bn a year and is deliberately not stacked into

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: the capital bars. Read this as scale, not as cost structure: Epoch derives both components from IT power with a fixed cost-per-watt

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: model, so the chips/buildings ratio is identical for every owner by construction and carries no information about how differently

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: these companies build. Only the totals differ. Nothing here is reported company spend, and it should not be reconciled against capex

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start
